hero.title: The BIM platform with <grad>AI Copilot</grad> and Extended Reality in the browser.
hero.lead: Load IFC models at 1:1 scale, coordinate disciplines, simulate 4D schedule, review clashes and 5D costs, and walk through the project in VR or AR — all in one platform, no installation required.

features.title: Everything your BIM team needs, in one platform.
features.sub: From IFC upload to VR presentation for your client. No tool switching, no lost context.
features.viewer_desc: Support for IFC 2x3, IFC4 and IFC4.3 with high-performance Three.js rendering, LOD, culling and instancing for large models.
features.copilot_desc: Open with Ctrl+K and request BIM coordination, 4D simulation, 5D review, clash detection or guided walkthrough. The Copilot builds the scenario and acts in the viewer.
features.bim4d_desc: Link tasks to IFC elements, simulate construction with play/pause/seek, speed control and visual states per phase.
features.bim5d_desc: Extract quantities from the model, link costs per element and track budgeted vs. actual in real time.
features.vr_desc: Native WebXR: enter VR with Quest, Vive or other headsets, or open in AR on mobile — directly in the browser, no app needed.
features.api_desc: Tenant isolation, JWT with automatic refresh, roles and permissions, and a documented REST API /api/v1.

how.title: From IFC to client in three steps.
how.step1_desc: Drag the file into the platform. ArxisVR parses it, indexes properties and prepares the model for collaborative use.
how.step2_desc: Federate disciplines, request reviews from Copilot, configure 4D schedule and 5D quantities. AI executes safe actions in the viewer.
how.step3_desc: Save scenarios and share a link. The client joins directly in the browser — desktop, mobile or VR headset.

pricing.title: Start free. Scale when you need.
pricing.sub: No credit card required to start. Change plans anytime.

cta.title: Ready to see your project in a new dimension?
cta.sub: Create your free account and upload an IFC in under 2 minutes. No installation, no credit card.
